AI Governance That Builds Trust & Protects Revenue

Customers, partners and regulators want to know your AI is safe, fair and responsible — without slowing your business down. We help you build a simple, practical AI governance system using tools you already have — in weeks, not years.

Safe & Responsible AI No New Tools Needed Fast & Low Cost Audit-Ready Proof Protects Your Brand
See a Sample AI Governance System AI Governance Services

At a Glance

  • Standard: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (Responsible AI Governance)
  • Outcome: Safe, trusted AI that protects your reputation and revenue
  • Time: Weeks, not years — using your existing tools

Why AI Governance Matters to Your Business

AI is transforming your products and services — but it also brings real business risks: data leaks, bias complaints, regulatory fines, and loss of customer trust. ISO 42001 gives you a simple, repeatable way to manage those risks — so you can innovate fast while keeping everyone confident.

Protect Your Brand & Reputation

Show customers and partners your AI is safe, fair and explainable — no more “black box” worries.

Avoid Costly Fines & Delays

Get ahead of new AI laws and regulations — before they slow down your deals or hit your bottom line.

Enable Safe, Fast Innovation

Clear rules and approval processes mean your teams can build and deploy AI confidently — without chaos.

What AI Governance Really Looks Like (No Jargon)

Think of it as a simple set of rules and checks — like a safety system for AI. You decide what AI is allowed, who approves it, how you watch it, and what happens when something goes wrong.

Clear Rules & Responsibilities

Who can use AI? Who approves new uses? Who watches for problems? We define the roles and rules.

One List of All AI Uses

A single, up-to-date register of every AI tool or model — what it does, who owns it, and how risky it is.

Check for Risks Before Launch

Quick reviews to catch data leaks, bias, or misuse — before they become headlines.

Human Oversight Where It Matters

For high-risk AI, a person reviews or can override decisions — keeping humans in control.

Ongoing Monitoring & Fixes

Watch how AI performs over time and fix issues quickly — so it stays safe and reliable.

Proof Ready for Audits

Everything is documented and timestamped — so when auditors or customers ask, you have clean, defensible answers.

Top AI Risks Every Business Leader Should Watch

AI can be powerful — but it also introduces real business risks. ISO 42001 helps you spot and manage them before they hurt your brand or revenue.

Data Leaks

Staff accidentally sharing confidential info with public AI tools.
How we help: Private AI, data loss prevention rules, staff training.

Uncontrolled AI Use

Teams using unapproved AI tools without oversight.
How we help: One central register and approval process.

Bias & Unfair Outcomes

AI making decisions that unfairly affect people or groups.
How we help: Bias testing and diverse data reviews.

Wrong or Misleading Answers

AI confidently giving incorrect information.
How we help: Human review for important decisions.

Privacy Violations

Personal data used without proper permission.
How we help: Privacy checks built into approvals.

AI Performance Drops Over Time

AI becoming less accurate as data changes.
How we help: Ongoing monitoring and quick fixes.

Proof You Can Show – Using Tools You Already Have

You don't need new software. We use Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Power Automate, Defender, etc.) to create clear, timestamped proof that's ready for auditors or customers.

SharePoint Folders

One secure place for policies, approvals, risk reviews and incident logs — with automatic versioning.

Automated Snapshots

Power Automate takes monthly pictures of settings and logs — stored with dates and owners.

Saved Reports

Quick exports from Defender, Sentinel and Purview — ready to share when asked.

Quick-Start Plan: Get AI Governance in 90 Days

  • Publish simple AI rules & assign owners
  • Set up a secure SharePoint area
  • Start a list of all AI uses

Weeks 3–6

Common Questions About AI Governance

How is AI governance different from cyber security?

Cyber security protects information. AI governance ensures the AI itself is used safely, fairly and responsibly.

Do we need new software?

No. Most organisations can build a strong AI governance system using Microsoft 365 tools you already have.

What will auditors want to see?

A clear list of AI uses, risk reviews, approvals, and monitoring records — all with dates and owners.

Want safe, trusted AI in weeks — not years?

We'll show you how to build AI governance using your existing tools — fast, low-cost, and audit-ready.
